title: Standalone export followed hostile resource slugs outside the catalogue

reproductions.test: does not resolve a resource slug that traverses above the resource root
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: resolver returned the external index.tsx contents for a ../../resource-resolver-audit-* slug.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: noncanonical slugs resolve to null.

reproductions.test: does not read a resource directory symlink that points outside the resource root
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: resolver returned source from a valid-looking slug whose resource directory linked to a sibling folder.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: linked resource directories are skipped.

reproductions.test: fails a standalone export instead of copying a source file named by a hostile project manifest
reproductions.beforeFix: The direct resolver regressions demonstrated that generateSourceTree would receive the sibling source through the registered Node adapter.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: export stops with an unresolved-resource error and does not create an output tree containing the external source.
